status: planned before fitting either backbone; posthoc exposed-development diagnostic
scope: Existing 112 NLI inputs per backbone; 84 train in 42 mother groups, 28 dev in 14 mother groups; train R5 30 pairs, strong 12; dev R5 10, strong 4. No confirmation inputs.
features: Mean of two separately RMS-normalized last-position hidden vectors, fixed 4096 dimensions. Frozen backbone; no new forwards.
base_margin: Mean over two mappings of native-semantic positive logit minus negative logit. This changes probabilities from historical mean-softmax, so preserve both zero-margin-update and saved base probability/NLL controls. Binary decisions are mathematically identical.

optimizer.checkpoint: minimum mother-weighted dev native NLL; epoch 0 included

loss: Mother-balanced BCE; +JS only on 30 training R5 pairs with same gold, unit-balanced. Strong controls are supervised but not JS-paired.
semantic_parameterization: One weight vector of 4096 entries, no bias; semantic margin=base_margin+h_sem dot w
bias_parameterization: One scalar added to the same base margin; same fitting/selection grid, both CE/CE+JS
prior: Training mother-weighted positive-label frequency; dev gold is not used to estimate prior
metrics: train/dev R5 and strong input correctness, paired both correctness, reference/variant and positive/negative endpoint accuracy
repairs and harms versus same-margin zero, saved mean-probability base, prior and bias calibration
limitations: Posthoc diagnostic triggered by existing results, not independent confirmation.
Fixed semantic labels are intrinsic to visible NLI task, but this probe is not a general arbitrary-option learned head.
Decision-only CPU reuse; no new complete native explanation and no new GPU call.
